findings: Genuine rich quotes retain a plain left rule, bold/italic and their identity.
Mixed ordered/checklist/bullet hierarchy retains marker nesting, checked state and sibling order through deep child edits and exact saved Undo.
Native list Shift Enter shows both text lines and the inserted blank line in full; Undo restores adjacent original lines.
Narrow nested-list capture shows the complete hierarchy within the pane; target geometry and viewport overflow checks pass.
Heading marks/alignment, wrapped title, code and table remain intact. Loading and clean restart are retained.
limits: Disposable profile; no provider turn, navigation activation or real-library cutover.
Two-fps review is not every source video frame; original recordings retained.
Some individual edit stills put the caret near the viewport bottom; targeted list-break/narrow stills supply full-context evidence.
Clean Electron restart does not prove power-loss durability.
